Part of [Cycling in Dublin](index.qmd). See also [Lower Kilmacud Road](kilmacud-road-lower.qmd).

## The plan

DLR consulted on the **Stillorgan Village Area Movement Framework Plan** from 28 October to 9 December 2015. It's being built in phases. Phases 1 and 2, on Lower Kilmacud Road between South Avenue and Kilmacud Crokes, are done.

## Phase 4A: Old Dublin Road

Phase 4A covers the Old Dublin Road from St Lawrence's Park to Stillorgan College of Further Education. The council consulted from 21 May to 18 June 2025 and got 125 submissions, and the report was noted in December 2025.

The published plans are for wider footpaths and public realm work. We couldn't find a cycle track in them.

Construction was due to start in the second quarter of 2026. In January 2026 that moved to the first quarter of 2027.

## The rest

Phases 3 and 4B, covering Lower Kilmacud Road, The Hill and the rest of the Old Dublin Road, have no published timing.

## Questions for the council

1. Does Phase 4A include any cycling provision on the Old Dublin Road? If not, why not?
2. Is the first quarter of 2027 still the start date for Phase 4A?
3. When will Phases 3 and 4B be designed and consulted on?
4. How will the Stillorgan village phases connect to the DLR Connector on Lower Kilmacud Road?

The contact is DLR's Active Travel team, [cycling@dlrcoco.ie](mailto:cycling@dlrcoco.ie).
